verdict.rationale: Jules explicitly runs in a cloud VM that clones code, installs dependencies, and modifies files, providing an isolated sandbox for agent execution (jules-docs-3), with plan approval before changes are made (jules-docs-4) and diff/PR review workflows (jules-docs-7, jules-docs-8). Community reports corroborate real-world usage of this cloud-VM execution model, including complaints that it's cloud-based rather than local, confirming the sandbox architecture is real and functioning. missing for 10: no detailed documentation of sandbox security boundaries, resource isolation guarantees, or independent security audit of the VM isolation.
